learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected About the same and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Hospital A fifteen births per day showed 53 days over sixty percent boys, expected 55. B forty-five showed 30, expected 25. Returned A. Home five births showed 73, expected 68; End one hundred showed three, expected six.
observations.reveal: Corrected to smaller A, distinguished seeded year from expectations, explained ten of fifteen versus at least twenty-eight of forty-five, and stated real births about fifty-one percent while model uses fifty.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Daily-share dots, fifty and sixty percent lines, extreme-color dots and retained A/B counts legible. At one hundred births dots visibly clustered near midpoint; explanation readable.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.

prediction.reason: Equal probability with different sample sizes creates a meaningful qualitative commitment.
prediction.evidence: Same selected against smaller and larger hospitals.

interaction.reason: Two presets and broad size range expose spread differences.
interaction.evidence: Fifteen, forty-five, five and one hundred tested.

payoff.reason: Reveal separates sampled count from expected rate and explains threshold counts.

clarity.reason: Dot meaning, strict over-sixty threshold and expectation are explicit.
clarity.evidence: Each dot is one day; fifty-percent model caveat.

transfer.reason: General small-sample principle stated without a concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Most extreme percentages come from smallest samples.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard sample-size endpoints worked; screen reader, contrast and reduced motion unaudited.

surprise.reason: Same underlying chance yields different frequency of extremes.
surprise.evidence: Smaller hospital more than twice expected extreme days.

visualExplanation.evidence: Tighter cluster at one hundred births.

playfulness.reason: Size slider recalculates a seeded year.

practicalValue.reason: Supports interpreting percentages from unequal sample sizes.

depth.reason: Combines sampling variation and expectation versus realization.
depth.evidence: Seeded counts differ from long-run averages.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Separate equal event probability from variability of sample proportions.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Two hospital presets and one size slider.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: Sampling variation and expected counts explained with examples.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: Percentages, sample sizes and daily dot chart.

whyCool: Equal odds do not make small and large groups equally stable.
caveat: One seeded year illustrates variation; no fresh sample-domain application was attempted.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
